summary: The team began sprint planning and addressed a Kubernetes memory issue, planning to migrate PostgreSQL to a managed instance by Friday. They discussed a proposal to switch the CI/CD pipeline from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, which will be revisited next week. A decision was made to use OAuth with JWT tokens for the new login API, and the need to update the Swagger documentation was noted.
